method.source: synthetic: 10,000,000 rows computed per request in the page (an id, a number, a category), nothing stored; each answer waits `latency` ms on a timer (also at 0)
method.jump: after a pause (GC, a frame, 50 ms), from the scroll command (model.scrollTo / api.ensureIndexVisible) to the first frame in which that row is within a row of the viewport's top and every row covering the viewport is mounted in order showing its id, read just before the frame paints; frame rate limit off; seeded random rows over the whole range
method.trace: the top row moved every frame at a speed in rows a second for 2 s (vsync on); requests started and aborted per second, and the share of frames in which some row in view was not loaded
method.memory: CDP Runtime.getHeapUsage after forced GC (V8 + Blink heaps + ArrayBuffer backing stores) after mounting and jumping to 50 places, over the page with a grid mounted and destroyed once; then four more rounds (mount, 50 jumps, destroy): what each leaves beyond the one before
